A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the signal recognition particle is an RNA-protein complex that is composed of a 7S RNA and at least six proteins (Walter and Blobel 1982a).
the SRP receptor has a dual function in the protein transport process: It acts as a membrane receptor for the SRP, and it serves as a docking site for the nascent chain.

the SRP receptor has a dual role in the transport of secretory and membrane proteins: it is the docking site for the SRP and, after dissociation of the complex, the translocation site for nascent polypeptides.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there are two different mechanisms that are involved in the translocation of proteins across the membrane.
there are a variety of ways that proteins can get across the membrane.
